nodes.title: Main theorem
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] [Group.IsSolvable G], ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra ℚ K) (_ : FiniteDimensional ℚ K) (_ : IsGalois ℚ K), Nonempty (G ≃* (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K))

nodes.title: Nilpotent semidirect products preserve Galois realizability over ℚ
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (N S : Type*) [Group N] [Finite N] [Group.IsNilpotent N] [Group S] [Finite S] (θ : S →* MulAut N), (∃ (E : Type) (_ : Field E) (_ : Algebra ℚ E) (_ : FiniteDimensional ℚ E) (_ : IsGalois ℚ E), Nonempty (S ≃* (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E))) → ∃ (L : Type) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra ℚ L) (_ : FiniteDimensional ℚ L) (_ : IsGalois ℚ L), Nonempty ((N ⋊[θ] S) ≃* (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L))

nodes.title: Finite solvable groups admit smaller nilpotent semidirect covers
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] [Group.IsSolvable G] [Nontrivial G], ∃ (N S : Subgroup G) (θ : S →* MulAut N) (q : (N ⋊[θ] S) →* G), N.Normal ∧ Group.IsNilpotent N ∧ Group.IsSolvable S ∧ Nat.card S < Nat.card G ∧ Function.Surjective q

nodes.title: Galois realizability descends along finite group quotients
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (H G : Type*) [Group H] [Finite H] [Group G] [Finite G], (∃ (L : Type) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra ℚ L) (_ : FiniteDimensional ℚ L) (_ : IsGalois ℚ L), Nonempty (H ≃* (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L))) → (∃ q : H →* G, Function.Surjective q) → ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra ℚ K) (_ : FiniteDimensional ℚ K) (_ : IsGalois ℚ K), Nonempty (G ≃* (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K))

nodes.title: An open finite quotient of the absolute Galois group is realizable
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G], (∃ ψ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ →* G, Function.Surjective ψ ∧ IsOpen (ψ.ker : Set (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ))) → ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra ℚ K) (_ : FiniteDimensional ℚ K) (_ : IsGalois ℚ K), Nonempty (G ≃* (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K))

nodes.title: Proper solvability of finite split embedding problems with nilpotent kernel over ℚ
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (N S : Type*) [Group N] [Finite N] [Group.IsNilpotent N] [Group S] [Finite S] (θ : S →* MulAut N) (φ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ →* S), Function.Surjective φ → IsOpen (φ.ker : Set (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ)) → ∃ ψ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ →* (N ⋊[θ] S), Function.Surjective ψ ∧ IsOpen (ψ.ker : Set (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ)) ∧ (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : (N ⋊[θ] S) →* S).comp ψ = φ

nodes.title: A finite Galois realization gives an open quotient of the absolute Galois group
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (S : Type*) [Group S] [Finite S], (∃ (E : Type) (_ : Field E) (_ : Algebra ℚ E) (_ : FiniteDimensional ℚ E) (_ : IsGalois ℚ E), Nonempty (S ≃* (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E))) → ∃ φ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ →* S, Function.Surjective φ ∧ IsOpen (φ.ker : Set (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ))

nodes.title: Nilpotence lifts through the ambient Frattini subgroup
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (M : Subgroup G), M.Normal → frattini G ≤ M → Group.IsNilpotent (M ⧸ (frattini G).subgroupOf M) → Group.IsNilpotent M

nodes.title: A nilpotent normal subgroup strictly above Frattini
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] [Group.IsSolvable G] [Nontrivial G], ∃ N : Subgroup G, N.Normal ∧ Group.IsNilpotent N ∧ frattini G < N

nodes.title: A normal subgroup and a supplement give a semidirect surjection
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (N S : Subgroup G), N.Normal → N ⊔ S = ⊤ → ∃ (θ : S →* MulAut N) (q : (N ⋊[θ] S) →* G), Function.Surjective q

nodes.title: Assemble p-subgroup lifts into a nilpotent-kernel lift
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (Γ : Type*) [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] (N S : Type*) [Group N] [Finite N] [Group.IsNilpotent N] [Group S] [Finite S] (θ : S →* MulAut N) (φ : Γ →* S), Function.Surjective φ → IsOpen (φ.ker : Set Γ) → (∀ (p : ℕ) (P : Subgroup N), Nat.Prime p → IsPGroup p P → ∀ η : S →* MulAut P, ∃ ψ : Γ →* (P ⋊[η] S), Function.Surjective ψ ∧ IsOpen (ψ.ker : Set Γ) ∧ (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : (P ⋊[η] S) →* S).comp ψ = φ) → ∃ ψ : Γ →* (N ⋊[θ] S), Function.Surjective ψ ∧ IsOpen (ψ.ker : Set Γ) ∧ (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : (N ⋊[θ] S) →* S).comp ψ = φ

nodes.title: Proper lifts with finite p-group kernel over ℚ
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) (P S : Type*) [Group P] [Finite P] [Group S] [Finite S] (θ : S →* MulAut P) (φ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ →* S), Nat.Prime p → IsPGroup p P → Function.Surjective φ → IsOpen (φ.ker : Set (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ)) → ∃ ψ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ →* (P ⋊[θ] S), Function.Surjective ψ ∧ IsOpen (ψ.ker : Set (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ)) ∧ (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : (P ⋊[θ] S) →* S).comp ψ = φ

nodes.title: Normality of the Sylow join over a nilpotent quotient
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (M N : Subgroup G) [M.Normal] [N.Normal], N ≤ M → Group.IsNilpotent (M ⧸ N.subgroupOf M) → ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (P : Sylow p M), (N ⊔ (P : Subgroup M).map M.subtype).Normal

nodes.title: The Frattini argument forces ambient Sylow normality
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (M : Subgroup G) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (P : Sylow p M), frattini G ≤ M → (frattini G ⊔ (P : Subgroup M).map M.subtype).Normal → ((P : Subgroup M).map M.subtype).Normal

nodes.title: Lift an abelian normal quotient subgroup above the kernel
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal] (A : Subgroup (G ⧸ K)), A.Normal → IsMulCommutative A → A ≠ ⊥ → ∃ N : Subgroup G, N.Normal ∧ K < N ∧ Group.IsNilpotent (N ⧸ K.subgroupOf N)

nodes.title: A nontrivial abelian normal subgroup of a solvable group
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (Q : Type*) [Group Q] [Group.IsSolvable Q] [Nontrivial Q], ∃ A : Subgroup Q, A.Normal ∧ IsMulCommutative A ∧ A ≠ ⊥

nodes.title: Equivariant pushforward preserves proper lifts and open kernels
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (Γ : Type*) (A : Type*) (P : Type*) (T : Type*) (S : Type*) [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [IsTopologicalGroup Γ] [Group A] [Group P] [Group T] [Group S] (σ : T →* MulAut A) (θ : S →* MulAut P) (q : A →* P) (α : T ≃* S) (r : Γ →* T) (ell : Γ →* (A ⋊[σ] T)), Function.Surjective q → (∀ (t : T) (a : A), q (σ t a) = θ (α t) (q a)) → Function.Surjective ell → IsOpen (ell.ker : Set Γ) → (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : (A ⋊[σ] T) →* T).comp ell = r → ∃ ψ : Γ →* (P ⋊[θ] S), Function.Surjective ψ ∧ IsOpen (ψ.ker : Set Γ) ∧ (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : (P ⋊[θ] S) →* S).comp ψ = α.toMonoidHom.comp r

nodes.title: Termination of the descending p-central series of a finite p-group
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) (P : Type*) [Group P] [Finite P] (C : ℕ → Subgroup P), Nat.Prime p → IsPGroup p P → C 0 = ⊤ → (∀ n : ℕ, C (n + 1) = Subgroup.closure ({x : P | ∃ a : P, a ∈ C n ∧ x = a ^ p} ∪ {x : P | ∃ a : P, a ∈ C n ∧ ∃ b : P, x = a * b * a⁻¹ * b⁻¹})) → ∃ m : ℕ, C m = ⊥
